remarks: Impeccable 1BR just steps to downtown! Newly renovated kitchen features quartz countertops, recessed lighting, abundant white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, breakfast nook, black tile flooring, dishwasher, gas cooking & Microwave. Unit offers hardwood floors, high ceilings & great closets throughout. Bright living room with large windows & crown molding. Spacious, sunny bedroom with new windows. Updated bath with tile backsplash. Heat & hot water included. Charming complex with quiet landscaped courtyard & new walkways. Easy commute-close to shops, dining & transit. Off-street parking.
